verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a probe showing a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at motherduck.com/openapi.json. That is the foundation an interactive API reference could be built on, but nothing shows MotherDuck actually renders one or offers try-it/runnable examples. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference UI, runnable or try-it-now examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration of such an explorer.
